stem.text: The graph shows the effect of increasing substrate concentration on the rate of reaction of two enzymes that catalyse reactions with the same substrate.

stem.alt: Graph of rate of reaction against substrate concentration, with two curves labelled enzyme P (dashed) and enzyme Q (solid).

A.text: Enzyme Q has a higher $K_\text{m}$ and a higher affinity for the substrate than enzyme P.

B.text: Enzyme Q has a higher $K_\text{m}$ and a lower affinity for the substrate than enzyme P.

C.text: Enzyme Q has a lower $K_\text{m}$ and a higher affinity for the substrate than enzyme P.

D.text: Enzyme Q has a lower $K_\text{m}$ and a lower affinity for the substrate than enzyme P.
